resources.string: Java games (.jar / .jad) and Mophun games (.mpn) do not need phone firmware.

Phone: Nokia N-Gage or N-Gage QD.

Needed: a phone dump prepared for EKA2L1, as a ZIP/7z archive or a .rom file with its matching .rpkg when required.

N-Gage 2.0 installers are for a different platform and will not replace these files.

Phone: an S60 1st/2nd edition model matching the game, such as Nokia 3650 or 6600.\n\nNeeded: an EKA2L1 phone dump, as a ZIP/7z archive or .rom with its matching .rpkg when required. A game .sis is not phone firmware.

Phone: the Symbian generation required by the game, for example Nokia N95 for S60 3rd edition.\n\nNeeded: an EKA2L1 phone dump, as a ZIP/7z archive or .rom with its matching .rpkg when required. Different Symbian generations are not interchangeable.

Phone: Nokia N95 recommended (S60 3rd edition).

%1$s

%2$s

Use the N-Gage 2.0 platform installer (.sis or ZIP), not a .n-gage game. Saved files are reused; platform installation is checked when adding a game.
Phone dump: needed (.rom + matching .rpkg, or prepared ZIP/7z).
N-Gage 2.0 app: installer needed if not already installed on the phone.
This game needs original Nokia N-Gage / N-Gage QD system files.
This game needs S60 3rd edition system files (N95 recommended) and the N-Gage 2.0 platform installer.
This game needs system files for a supported Symbian S60 1st/2nd edition phone.
This game needs system files for its Symbian generation (S60 3rd edition or later).

An EKA2L1 phone dump contains the phone\'s operating system, not games. Add a ZIP/7z containing one .rom and its matching .rpkg, or select those files together. Subfolders and uppercase extensions are supported. Both files must be from the same phone dump; do not mix several phones or games in this archive. A prepared ROM + Z-folder archive is also supported.\n\nUse files you have the right to use. Firmware and games are not included.

%2$s

Phone system files are ready. Add the N-Gage 2.0 platform installer (SIS or ZIP), not a game. AbyssME keeps a copy for later games.
The previous installation did not finish. Your game is kept. Retrying may reinstall files on the selected phone.

%1$s\n\nAdd this component\'s SIS/SISX installer, or a ZIP containing it. Use a version for this Symbian phone. Your game is kept; installation continues after you add the file. The installer is saved for later games.
The installed game is available in your library.
Only the retained import is removed. Original files, installed games and saves stay untouched.
